---
title: "Stress on Truss"
subtitle: "2D truss structure with stiff springs and observed forces"
---

Replicates the [NetworkDynamics.jl Stress on Truss tutorial](https://juliadynamics.github.io/NetworkDynamics.jl/stable/generated/stress_on_truss/) — a 2D truss of point masses connected by stiff beams. Free vertices move under gravity and spring forces; fixed vertices act as supports. Demonstrates heterogeneous vertex types, 2D coupling (`insym`/`outsym`), observed functions (`obsf`), and per-edge parameters.

## YAML Specification

```{python}
#| echo: false
from IPython.display import Code, Markdown
Code(filename="yaml/stress_on_truss.yaml", language="yaml")
```

## Model Report

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file("yaml/stress_on_truss.yaml")
Markdown(exp.generate_report())
```

## Generated Julia Code

```{python}
from tvbo import SimulationExperiment
exp = SimulationExperiment.from_file("yaml/stress_on_truss.yaml")
Code(exp.render_code("networkdynamics"), language='julia')
```

## Run & Plot

```{python}
ts = exp.run(format="networkdynamics")
ts.plot()
```

## Results

```{python}
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
# Free vertices only (9 of 11 nodes have states)
x_data = ts.data[:, 2, :, 0]   # x position
y_data = ts.data[:, 3, :, 0]   # y position
print(f"Shape: {ts.data.shape}")
print(f"Time range: {ts.time[0]:.1f} – {ts.time[-1]:.1f}")
print(f"x range: [{x_data.min():.3f}, {x_data.max():.3f}]")
print(f"y range: [{y_data.min():.3f}, {y_data.max():.3f}]")
```
